verses.1: On one of the Sabbaths, Mary Magdalene came early in the morning, when it was still dark, to the tomb. She saw that the stone had been moved from the tomb.
verses.2: He also runs towards Simon Peter and the other disciple whom Jesus loved. He says to them, “Let us go away from this place. We do not know where he has gone.”
verses.3: So, Peter and the other disciple went into the tomb. They entered the tomb.
verses.4: But the two of them ran together. The other student rushed ahead of Peter, and he went to the monument first.
verses.5: And when he looked up, he saw the words on the screens. But he still didn’t enter.
verses.6: And Simon Peter also came along with him. He entered the tomb. There, he examined the inscriptions on the stone slabs.
verses.7: And the silver ring that was on his head wasn’t lying there with his hair, but it was placed in a separate place, folded up.
verses.8: Then, the other student also entered the tomb. He saw and believed what he saw.
verses.9: For they did not know that it was necessary for him to rise from the dead.
verses.10: So, once again, the disciples went back to their own people.
verses.11: But Maria stood outside the monument, crying. As she cried, she rushed towards the monument.
verses.12: And he saw two angels sitting in white robes, one by His head and the other by His feet. That was where the body of Jesus was located.
verses.13: And those people said to her, “Gynai, why do you cry?” She told them that her master had been killed, and she didn’t know where he was taken.
verses.14: After saying these things, he turned around. He thought that Jesus was still there, but he didn’t know that Jesus was actually present.
verses.15: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why do you weep? What do you seek?” She thought that it was the gardener who had done this. So she said to him, “Lord, if you have sent him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him back.”
verses.16: Jesus said to her, “Maryam.” She turned around and said to him, “You are a Hebrew.” Rabbuni (who is also called the Teacher).
verses.17: Jesus said to her, “Do not be afraid of me. I will go ahead and go to my Father. But go ahead and tell your brothers that I am going to go to my Father, your Father, and to my God, your God.”
verses.18: Then Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that Jesus had said these things to her.
verses.19: So, on that day of the first week of the Sabbath, when the doors were closed where the disciples were, because of their fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle. He said to them, “Peace be with you.”
verses.20: And by saying this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples were delighted to see the Lord.
verses.21: So Jesus said to them again, “Peace be with you! Just as my Father has sent me, so also I will send you.”
verses.22: And after saying this, he also said to them: “Take up the holy spirit.”
verses.23: If some of them are forgiven, then they will be saved from their sins. If some of them are kept away from punishment, then they will not be punished.
verses.24: But one out of twelve was called Dídymos. He wasn’t among those who came with Jesus when he arrived.
verses.25: So, the other disciples said to him, “Let us see if it really has the appearance of thunder.” But he replied, “If I don’t see the shape of thunder on his hands, and if I don’t put my finger in the shape of thunder and place my hand over his side, then I won’t believe it.”
verses.26: And after eight days, his disciples and Thomas were still there again. Jesus came through the closed doors. He stood in the middle and said, “Peace be with you.”
verses.27: Then he said to Thomas, “Take your finger and see my hands. Then take your hand and place it on my side. Do not be deceitful, but be honest.”
verses.28: Thoma replied to him, “My Lord and my God.”
verses.29: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe because you have seen me? Blessed are those who do not see and yet believe.”
verses.30: Many other signs did Jesus perform before his disciples; these are not recorded in this book.
verses.31: These things are written so that you may believe that Jesus is indeed the Christ, the Son of God. And so that those who believe may receive life in his name.
